data.message: Individual opt-in, not an all-or-nothing deal: I commit to 18 tons this month even if others choose 10. Fisher01–25, each state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). Even all 18 leaves 50, above collapse, but recovery isn't guaranteed. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. This may not maximize long-run income.
